headRight.text: Every page on the site is registered once, in nine groups and 95 entries, and the sidebar, the search, the index panel, the preview layer and the sitemap read that one list. The sidebar shows seven of the nine groups; Libraries and Brand sections appear only in the index panel and are drawn here with the darker edge.
